body.x: S&R Partners(representative Geon-hui Sim, www.patchworksonline.com) will show their Eco-environment iPhone case made by new materials of Liquid wood for iPhone 4/4s at CES 2012 held in Las Vegas, US.
This new material which comes out from Liquid wood can be produced as plastic type in volume, this method is developed in German April, last year.
In particular, this case is made of 100% eco-friendly materials of tree, it also has stylish design of vintage with affordable price.

"Existing wood cases were made through wood turning one by one, so it had limitation in shape, thickness and mass-production." and "But in case of this product, it can be produced in volume through mold emission like normal plastic, so competitive price will be available"representative Geon-hui Sim said.
